combat.offer: Bubba: Hold on, darlin'. Before you swing at anything, do you want me to walk you through the buttons?
normal: Bubba: One action each per round, in order of speed. Pick it off the list and press [CONTINUE].
Bubba: Attack swings whatever you are holding at whoever you point it at. It never greys out: it is the one thing you are never left without.
Bubba: Defense braces you and cuts what lands on you for the round. Carrying a gun, that row is Reload instead: it fills the magazine and covers you all the same.
Bubba: Skills is the loadout you packed, each row priced in MP or TP. Basic is the plain kit you carry whatever you forget.
Bubba: Aim names a limb before the swing and costs you no turn. Wrestle takes hold of the thing with your bare hands.
Bubba: Talk is talking, and some of them do listen. Item is the backpack, and Throw is the same bag hurled at somebody's head.
Bubba: Run always works, darlin'. No shame in it either: a corpse learns nothing.
map: Bubba: This one plays out where we are standing, so the map is the arena. Still one action each per round, in order of speed.
Bubba: Move walks you across the tiles before you act, once per round, as far as your legs and your DEX carry you.
Bubba: Attack only reaches as far as the range written on its row, so count the tiles between you and it before you swing.
Bubba: Skills, Basic, Aim, Wrestle, Talk, the backpack and Throw all work the way they do indoors, only pointed at a tile.
Bubba: The cursor is how you name that tile: step it onto what you want and press [CONTINUE].
Bubba: Run walks the whole party out, unless something has hold of us.
combat.rearm: Bubba: No problem darlin', I'm no magic expert but i can reteach you how to shoot your gun! You need to figure out the rest yourself
